title: DL for Tabular data
summary: A final project for a Machine Learning for Data Science course that applies deep learning and classical models to classify surface defects in the Steel Plates Faults dataset, addressing class imbalance with SMOTENC and synthetic oversampling. The standalone ctgan package is imported and run in utils/ctgan_oversampling.py to generate synthetic minority-class tabular data for training.
